caption: The drawing depicts a single, rounded object that resembles a container or vessel with an irregular, bulbous body tapering towards the top and bottom. The main body of the object is a rich, mottled brown color with a variety of lighter spots and highlights, giving it a metallic or earthenware appearance. The vessel has a wide, circular base and a slightly wider rim at the top. On the top surface, there is a cylindrical protrusion at the center with a gray, twisted material inside it, as well as a smaller cylindrical tube beside it. At the base, there is a circular opening or spout on the left side. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or features present.
